questions.title: New Delhi scripts a post-US worldview
questions.subject: ir
questions.q: With reference to “New Delhi scripts a post-US worldview”, consider the following statements:
items: The New Delhi Declaration signifies a transformative shift in global dynamics, asserting a multipolar world that transcends Western dominance.
India's advocacy for UNSC reform further supports this newly conceived worldview, as BRICS actively engages with the shifting global landscape.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct.

questions.title: Tighter US Visa isn't all that bad for India
questions.subject: ir
questions.q: With reference to “Tighter US Visa isn't all that bad for India”, consider the following statements:
items: Stricter visa regulations in foreign nations will intensify competition for India's skilled workforce.
The imposition of job entry barriers in Western countries is hindering immigrant students, prompting universities to consider establishing more campuses overseas.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct.
